profile.name: Rana Romdhane
profile.title: AI/ML Engineer
profile.tagline: I design, train and ship machine learning systems, from predictive models and computer vision to LLM-powered assistants.
profile.summary: AI/ML Engineer with a Computer Science engineering degree and hands-on experience designing, training, and deploying end-to-end machine learning solutions spanning predictive modeling, computer vision, NLP, and LLM-based applications. Published researcher in Vision-Language Models, combining strong software engineering fundamentals, including modern React/TypeScript front-end development, with a focus on delivering measurable, production-ready results.

stats.label: Answer faithfulness of my RAG assistant

experience.headline: TransportAI: an intelligent public transport management platform
bullets: Designed and delivered TransportAI, an intelligent public transport management platform integrating a React analytical dashboard, an ML prediction engine, an assisted planning system, and a breakdown management module.

Benchmarked multiple regression models (Random Forest, XGBoost, Gradient Boosting, Linear Regression) for operational forecasting; selected Random Forest achieving R² = 0.997, enabling data-driven planning from previously underexploited company data.

Engineered a multilingual conversational assistant using a RAG pipeline (LangChain, ChromaDB) over a locally deployed LLM via Ollama, achieving 96% answer faithfulness on a 50-question evaluation set.

Architected a fully on-premise, cloud-independent stack (React, FastAPI, Oracle 11g, Ollama) and built the platform's responsive React front-end consuming FastAPI REST APIs, guaranteeing data confidentiality and operational autonomy.

experience.headline: AI-powered task management built on the GTD methodology
bullets: Developed a BERT-based NLP model reaching 87% accuracy in task prioritization across 10,000+ tasks within an AI-powered task management application (React/Next.js, GTD methodology).
Automated scheduling through calendar API integration, cutting manual planning time by 65%.

experience.headline: Financial data pipelines and executive dashboards
bullets: Automated ETL pipelines for financial data with Python and Power BI, reducing processing time by 60%.
Built 12+ executive KPI dashboards and analyzed 200K+ financial records to surface trends and anomalies.

projects.title: Vision-LLM for Compound Facial Emotion Recognition
projects.short: Fine-tuned BLIP-2 with LoRA to read 14 compound emotions at 96.81% accuracy.
projects.description: A multi-architecture study of compound facial emotion recognition, comparing classic vision backbones with Vision-Language Models and explaining what the best model actually looks at.
highlights: Benchmarked four architectures (ResNet50, ViT, LLaVA-1.5, BLIP-2) on the RAF-CE dataset (3,618 images, 14 classes).
Fine-tuned BLIP-2 with LoRA to 96.81% accuracy / 97.91% macro F1, a 117% gain over CNN baselines.
Validated model attention on facial action units using Grad-CAM and SHAP.
Deployed a real-time Streamlit demo.
